(() => { const ticks=[...document.querySelectorAll('.slice-tick')].filter(t=>t.getAttribute('data-tick')==='done').length; const stamps=[...document.querySelectorAll('.slice-completed')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim()); if(ticks!==8) throw Error('expected 8 ticks, got '+ticks); if(stamps.length!==8) throw Error('expected 8 stamps, got '+stamps.length); return ticks+' ticks, e.g. '+stamps[7]; })()
